# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 21 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam's Soul Departs; Angels Mourn

---

**1** Hearing all of this from Seth, Adam was deeply comforted. He said: 'Blessed is the Lord God, who does not abandon those who seek him.'

**2** Adam said: 'My sons, I know my hour has come. I am going to die. Don't grieve for me — just gather around me and take care of my body when I am gone.'

**3** Adam stretched out his hands and feet and gave up his spirit to God.

**4** The sun and moon went dark, and the stars stopped shining for seven days.

**5** The angels of God came and mourned over Adam. The firmament shook and all the heavens went dark.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
